visualizations.title: Actual vs Predicted Values (Heart Disease Output)
visualizations.description: Scatter plot comparing actual vs predicted heart disease output values with perfect prediction line. Shows model performance on both training and test data.

visualizations.title: Residuals Plot (Actual - Predicted) by Prediction Type
visualizations.description: Residuals plot showing actual-predicted differences against predicted values. Highlights model errors for training vs test data with a zero-line reference.

visualizations.title: Residuals Distribution (Actual - Predicted)
visualizations.description: Histogram with KDE showing the distribution of residuals (actual-predicted values). Highlights error distribution symmetry and magnitude with zero-line reference.

visualizations.title: Feature Correlation Matrix with Heart Disease Output
visualizations.description: Heatmap showing correlation coefficients between input features and heart disease output. Highlights relationships that may influence model predictions.

data.summary: The Random Forest Regressor achieved moderate predictive accuracy (R²=0.60) for heart disease output prediction. While the model shows reasonable performance, the systematic underprediction bias and 0.20 MAE suggest there is room for improvement through feature engineering or model optimization.
